sources.citation: Lama, Ziwo Qiu-Fuyuan. 2012. Subgrouping of Nisoic (Yi) Languages. PhD dissertation, University of Texas at Arlington.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing on Samei. Table 3.1 (p.66) lists 'Sanyi [sa21ȵi55]' recorded 2003 at Chang village, Ala township (= Samei) but the data were dropped from the study (p.65, only Sani kept); p.78 identifies Samei = Sanyi. The 'Samu 撒慕' profile (p.77: 32 initials, 38 finals, 7 tones) is Samataw of Zijun village, not Samei. The word 'stress' does not occur in the dissertation.
